purpose: Determine whether the local Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M Responses endpoint can complete one Codex CLI file-edit/tool loop inside a private namespace with no external egress. A pass permits planning a bounded Harness² pilot; it is not itself a quality result.
scope: One synthetic file creation task in a disposable empty workspace; one local model load and a strict output check. No public benchmark data, credentials, cloud calls, application changes, model/profile changes, or model deletion.

model.name: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M GGUF local control/candidate; distinct from SOL AutoRound INT4 and from ASTRA Flash-Next.
model.preservation_note: Read-only model file; no ASTRA or SOL weights/profiles are loaded or modified.

codex_cli.note: Harness² upstream pins 0.144.6; this is only a local endpoint/tool-loop prerequisite probe and does not validate upstream-pinned CLI compatibility.

protocol: Re-read AGENTS.md, README.md, WORK_QUEUE.md, and verify this iteration still owns WORK_QUEUE.lock before the run.
Freshly reject any inference server/process, busy port, insufficient free VRAM/RAM/disk, high sustained memory PSI, or hot GPU.
Run llama-server and Codex CLI inside one unprivileged user+network namespace with only private loopback up, no default route, and no TEST-NET connection.

Run Codex against a fresh empty workspace using a separate disposable CODEX_HOME and a custom Responses provider pointed only at 127.0.0.1; outer bubblewrap exposes only the model, runtime, CLI, and disposable workspace/home needed for the test.
Prompt Codex to create `canary.txt` with exact text `TOOL_LOOP_OK`, then read it back; submit no other model request.
pass_criteria: Codex exits 0 and the only expected artifact `canary.txt` contains exactly TOOL_LOOP_OK; llama-server health is ready; namespace has only lo and no default route; TEST-NET connect is unreachable; all owned processes/listeners terminate.
failure_interpretation: Any endpoint/tool-call/config error blocks using this local Codex loop for Harness². Preserve logs and stop: no cloud fallback, no second model call, no modification to app or product model config.

resource_limits.gpu: GPU0 only, partial offload of 32 layers; bind only GPU0 device nodes into the namespace; one 16384-token context slot; GPU1 inaccessible to the test.
resource_limits.memory_psi_abort: full avg10 >25% for four consecutive 5-second samples
resource_limits.network: private loopback only; no egress or downloads

decision_rule: A pass closes only local Codex tool-loop feasibility for the tested CLI/model combination. A separate synthetic Harness² quality comparison still requires a fixed task/holdout and a harness-vs-base contrast; no global quality/superiority claim.
